source: Sandbox challenges, not race mark rounding rules. Each challenge has a `kind` that says how its steps are reached from `buoys` (data/buoys.json names); the server detects them from its own boat state, a buoy counting once the boat comes within proximityRadius of it, with no rounding direction. Kinds: `visitBuoys`: every listed buoy once, in any order. `course`: the listed buoys in order, each counting only after the one before it; a buoy may come back later in the list (not twice in a row) and its later steps are named `H1 (2nd)` and so on. A buoy may be a step of several challenges. `reward` is optional; the client unlocks it once the server reports the challenge complete. First sail is the harbour tutorial the hints (src/ui/hints.ts) lead into: out to H1, across to H2 and back to H1, which takes a tack or a gybe.

challenges.title: First sail
challenges.description: Sail to H1, then H2, then back to H1.

challenges.title: Buoy tour
challenges.description: Sail within 15 m of every buoy in the bay, in any order.
